visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and glasses stands in front of a digital night market background. He wears a white short-sleeved button-down shirt and a black backpack. He looks up, sniffs the air, and makes a disgusted face as large yellow text overlays appear. (2) The man, now with sunglasses resting on his head, looks contemplative before reacting with extreme repulsion, covering his mouth and nose as if smelling something foul. Text at the bottom indicates '3 days later'. (3) The man holds a piece of stinky tofu with chopsticks, looking hesitant. He eats it and shows a conflicted, slightly nauseated expression. Text indicates '1 month later'. (4) The man eats stinky tofu with kimchi, looking slightly more accustomed but still reacting to the pungent smell. Text indicates '2 months later'. (5) The man eats fried stinky tofu; his eyes widen and his face contorts in a humorous expression of surprise at the good taste. Text indicates '3 months later'. (6) Wearing a vibrant orange sweatshirt, the man looks peaceful and happy, nodding while discussing his new love for the food. Text indicates '1 year later'. (7) The man expresses high excitement, holding his fists up as he mentions buying a tofu-shaped bed. Text indicates '3 years later'. (8) Scene transition to a bright, minimalist bedroom with white walls. The man is wearing a grey t-shirt and black shorts, jumping and rolling on a white mattress with square quilted patterns. He lies down comfortably next to a box of stinky tofu. (9) The man wears a blue basketball jersey and a backward black cap. He looks obsessed, rubbing a piece of stinky tofu on his neck like perfume and making an exaggeratedly satisfied face. Text indicates '30 years later'.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 外國人看到臭豆腐 30年來的改變. [Subtitle]: 喜歡臭豆腐嗎?. [Variety]: 來台第1天. [Subtitle]: 這是什麼味道... 那家店竟然在大量發酵 歐吉桑的襪子? 趕快逃~. (2) [Variety]: 3天後. [Subtitle]: 原來這叫臭豆腐啊 要吃吃看嗎? 真的無法. (3) [Variety]: 1個月後. [Subtitle]: 聽朋友說 放進嘴裡之後就不臭了 好臭好臭. (4) [Variety]: 2個月後. [Subtitle]: 聽朋友說 跟泡菜一起吃的話就沒那麼臭... 還是很臭啊. (5) [Variety]: 3個月後. [Subtitle]: 聽朋友說 炸臭豆腐的話... 少騙了!. (6) [Variety]: 1年後. [Subtitle]: 喔我常吃啊? 臭豆腐還是要 越臭越好吃吧. (7) [Variety]: 3年後. [Subtitle]: 最近太喜歡到 甚至還買了豆腐形狀的床墊耶 這個叫「眠豆腐」. (8) [Subtitle]: Q彈的獨立筒彈簧 加上高密度泡棉 同時達到柔軟舒適和彈力支撐 表面還是100%天絲材質 絲滑柔順不悶熱 睡起來超舒服 睡在這個眠豆腐上感覺做夢 都會夢到臭豆腐了. (9) [Variety]: 超棒的. [Variety]: 30年後. [Subtitle]: 光用吃的已經沒辦法滿足了 甚至好想每天跟它們 一起被發酵. 可是你這樣很臭啊 體臭? 才不是咧 這是最棒的香水吧 什麼臭豆腐 No! It's 香豆腐.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, childlike voice asking '喜歡臭豆腐嗎?' followed immediately by the male speaker's energetic Japanese speech. A bright acoustic guitar track with a rhythmic percussion bed plays at a moderate volume. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the change in visual phase. The speaker's voice rises in pitch and intensity, expressing theatrical disgust. (3) A cartoonish 'pop' sound effect coincides with the appearance of subtitles. The speaker's tone becomes quieter and more hesitant while eating, followed by high-pitched vocalizations of continued disgust. (4) During the mattress promotion phase, the speaker shifts to a clear, professional narrative delivery in Japanese, describing features with a rhythmic and persuasive inflection. The BGM remains steady and upbeat. (5) The final phase features a return to high-arousal, comedic shouting as the speaker makes an 'addiction' joke. The audio concludes with a sharp impact sound and a final stinger SFX.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously illustrate a foreigner's evolving relationship with stinky tofu over 30 years as a creative hook to promote the 'Sleepy Tofu' (眠豆腐) mattress brand.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names the brand '眠豆腐', showcases the product's physical attributes, and provides a direct promotional pitch.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses a cultural trope (foreigners' reaction to stinky tofu) to create engaging social-media content that leads into a highly relevant product placement based on a pun on the brand name.
